reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an interactive, draggable whale pet overlay which visually reflects agent session states and supports configurable skins.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加可交互、可拖拽并能反映智能体状态的桌宠浮层，支持配置宠物皮肤。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive, draggable desktop-pet overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that reflects agent states and supports configurable pet skins.

capabilities: Adds a persistent floating desktop-pet overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Maps harness session and turn events to pet animations and status bubbles
Supports click, hover, drag, and persisted overlay positioning
Supports configurable pet skins from bundled and user skin directories
